decision: Establish AEGIS-01 as an autonomous, scientifically rigorous survivability track within SUBJECT-01 without modifying main branch.
rationale: AEGIS-01 focuses on mechanical survivability, ballistics, hemostasis, and regeneration, complementing the metabolic/endurance research of SUBJECT-01 while maintaining strict ID isolation and zero collision.

decision: Classify reactive bullet dodging (AEGIS-NEU) as LEVEL D — CONTRADICTED / NO-GO; redirect neural focus to anticipatory perception and motor reflex optimization.
rationale: Physics and neurophysiology strictly prove that projectile flight time at combat distances (<70 ms) is shorter than biological sensorimotor latency (>= 30-108 ms). Claiming reactive bullet evasion violates physical causality.

decision: Adopt the Viscous Criterion (VC) and Backface Deformation (BFD <= 25mm) as mandatory non-negotiable pass criteria for AEGIS-BAL.
rationale: Arresting penetration while allowing fatal blunt force cardiac/thoracic crush (BABT) is an engineering failure. Real protection requires skeletal load-bridging.

decision: Mandate localized hemostasis mechanisms (topical sealants, sphincter-like microvascular spasm) and reject systemic hypercoagulation.
rationale: Systemic prothrombotic alterations induce lethal DIC, stroke, and pulmonary embolism, violating whole-organism viability criteria.

decision: Adopt the Acomys-inspired fibrosis-control model (TGF-beta3 / M2 macrophage polarization) and couple blastema activation with Peto-scale TP53 expansion.
rationale: Scarless dermal repair is biologically proven in mammals (Acomys), but unlimited somatic blastema cycling requires robust tumor suppressor expansion to prevent lethal malignancy.

decision: Reject continuous monolithic carapace architectures (ARCH-1) in favor of zoned modular protection (ARCH-4).
rationale: Full carapaces induce fatal exertion-induced heat stroke in <60 minutes due to sweat occlusion and degrade sprint speed by 40%. Zoned protection (55% vital area coverage) preserves thermoregulation and mobility.

decision: Enforce strict sequential ID namespace starting at HYP-0008, EXP-0037, FND-0038, NEG-0029, DEC-0015, ISS-0020, SRC-0068 for turnkey compatibility with SUBJECT-01 validator.
rationale: Guarantees zero identifier collision with SUBJECT-01 registry and satisfies tools/validate_repository.py stdlib validation constraints.

decision: Formal partitioning of research architectures into three isolated tiers: ARCH-BIO (Fully Endogenous), ARCH-HYBRID (Internal Biohybrid), and ARCH-SPEC (Speculative Biological Architecture). Rejection of external exoskeletons and wearable armor as primary endpoints.
rationale: Prevents conflation of biological feasibility with synthetic or speculative technologies, keeping core priority on internal biological solutions.

decision: Adoption of multi-axis functional regeneration framework (8 physiological recovery dimensions) and prioritization of tissue preservation (PEG membrane fusion) to bypass prolonged de novo axonal regrowth.
rationale: True recovery requires returning coordinated muscle strength, innervation, vascularity, and joint mobility rather than superficial wound closure.

decision: Mandatory Disaggregation of Peripheral Nerve and Muscle Recovery Metrics
rationale: To prevent false claims of rapid functional recovery, all future models and reports must independently report: (1) electrophysiological CNAP conduction, (2) sensory recovery, (3) motor axonal misdirection rate, and (4) contractile muscle torque.

decision: Classification of Ballistic and Knife Resistance Predictions as EXPLORATORY_NUMERICAL_UNVALIDATED
rationale: Mathematical formulations of V50 and blade cut resistance serve as comparative design guides but must never be declared as proven weapon protection without empirical live-fire or drop-tower testing.

decision: Adoption of Multi-Tier Scientific Model Status Classification (CODE_VERIFIED, PHYSICS_CONSISTENT, CALIBRATION_ONLY, EXTERNALLY_VALIDATED, UNVALIDATED, INVALIDATED)
rationale: To prevent epistemic over-claiming and conflation of numerical test passage with real-world empirical validation, all models, parameters, and claims must be assigned explicit scientific status labels based on verifiable physical and empirical criteria.

decision: Strategic Adoption of Option C (Focused Biohybrid Engineering & Live Empirical Protocol Design) for Cycle 5
rationale: Directs research to focus on empirical drop-tower and FEA bio-heat protocols rather than adding more unvalidated models.

decision: Forensic Revocation and Downgrade of Cycle 4B Validation Claims to PARTIAL and CONDITIONAL
rationale: Following discovery of synthetic VML data, biomaterials circular calibration, and normative ISO model substitution, all validation verdicts are formally downgraded to PARTIAL and ARCHITECTURE_BIOLOGICAL_FEASIBILITY is set to CONDITIONAL.
